name: Makiya Kasumi
source: A third-year student and the older sister of [url=/c27791]Sumika[/url]. Kasumi is a kind and refined girl who is the student council vice president. She likes spending her time researching things by watching the TV and using her mobile phone, which shocks [url=/c27785]Shoutarou[/url], because Kasumi comes sometimes off as a naive, sheltered girl. Makina is also the childhood friend of Shoutarou and has been interested in him for a long time.
